buildCommand: npx expo export --platform web --source-maps && { cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; } && { if [ -n "$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then { npx @sentry/cli sourcemaps inject dist && npx @sentry/cli sourcemaps upload --org=adventure-limitedraw --project=rawadventure --release="rawadventure@$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")" dist; } || echo 'Sentry sourcemaps upload failed (non bloquant)'; else echo 'SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN absent - upload sourcemaps saute'; fi; } && find dist -name '*.map' -delete
